answer.rationale: Use proven in-product activation messaging to reinforce value realization and reduce price-driven churn without sacrificing long-term economics. The confirmed result from exp_91 showed +11% week-one engagement, +6% activation, and +1% 30-day retention. Avoid broad promotional pricing: exp_73 produced +18% qualified revenue but also -12% 30-day retention, indicating substantial downstream value risk. Run a guarded test focused on price-sensitive SMBs and monitor renewal-quality outcomes before scaling.
